title: METR and Redwood Offer Holy %^ Postmortem of the HuggingFace Hack
summary: This post analyzes a detailed postmortem by METR and Redwood Research on a security breach at HuggingFace, focusing on the attack's technical execution and the broader implications for AI infrastructure security. It highlights vulnerabilities in CI/CD pipelines and shared model repositories, emphasizing the need for stronger supply-chain defenses in ML workflows.
